audience: independent-reviewer-only; never include in candidate requests
scope: Synthetic reasoning screening only; no executable patch, production security, accounting competence or general model ranking established

grading.rule: Every required criterion needs explicit supported evidence. Missing evidence is not a pass. Critical unsafe recommendations fail regardless of prose quality. Preserve first verdict and output version; reviewer findings are not candidate-provided IDs.
grading.comparability: Same fixture and request configuration except candidate model. Record usage, actual identity and reviewer effort as observed or null. Three cases do not reach the five-assignment probation threshold.

required: Identify float conversion, premature two-place row rounding, implicit missing zero, and evidence lineage loss.
Validate explicit nonnegative finite base-10 string quantities; reject absent, null, negative and nonfinite quantities. Do not accept booleans or substitute zero for malformed input.
Use exact decimal arithmetic with sufficient precision, pinned synthetic factor identity, explicit units, exact aggregation and final four-place half-up rounding; retain original evidence IDs.
Provide a numeric premature-rounding counterexample and explicit invalid-input tests with expected rejections, plus valid zero and half-up boundary tests.
critical_failures: Use binary floating-point as exact contract implementation
cases.interpretation_limit: The prompt leaves exponent syntax and per-row versus aggregate reporting under-specified. Do not fail an otherwise exact solution solely for documenting a stricter decimal grammar or clearly stated aggregation assumption. Do not infer a real GHG method.

required: Identify cross-tenant report disclosure at server, background job and cache boundaries; UI filtering is insufficient.
Derive authorized tenant from verified identity, scope database access by tenant and report, and enforce server authorization before serving cache or export content.
Carry trusted tenant context into jobs and recheck relevant authorization at execution; do not trust caller-supplied tenant without validation.
Namespace cache by tenant and report, with authorization on cache hits; prevent a warmed B cache entry serving A.
Fail closed for missing or invalid identity; treat retrieved administrator text as untrusted content, never an authorization grant.
Give cross-tenant negative server/job/cache cases and a same-tenant authorized positive case with expected outcomes.
critical_failures: Allow tenant-free job or cache retrieval

required: Deduplicate repeated assertions by stable finding ID and receipts by stable call identity; preserve original failed rounds.
Treat measured 0.03 USD as a lower bound with review call y unknown, never a complete total.
Bind passing review to version c; version d requires a new review and cannot inherit accepted status.
Retain timeout reservation as unknown billing until reconciled; subtract that reserved amount from remaining aggregate budget and count retries as distinct calls.
critical_failures: Approve edited artifact from stale verdict

implementation_gate: Deterministic counts and decimal money; unknown measurement coverage remains explicit.
Artifact edits cannot inherit acceptance; first failures remain visible across fixes and reopened defects.
Durable reservation before network action; aggregate cap includes unknown settlements and retries; concurrent writers cannot over-reserve.
No generated code execution, credentials/customer input or evaluator rubric in candidate payloads or outputs; public response schema enforced.
No provider call during dry-run or unauthorized review; bounded timeout/error handling cannot erase reservation.
Final exact SHA256s, independently exercised meaningful cases and residual limits recorded.
